interval: raw request wrapping/parsing, actual application evaluation, output validation/projection/copy/encoding, complete expected-byte comparison and dropping returned bytes
excluded: source preparation, retained native scratch allocation, process/file I/O, final report
failure_policy: Retain all rows. Mismatch/timeout/identity change makes collection incomplete. No row deletion or parameter tuning from timings. Below1ms rows retained with no ratio conclusion for that group.
limits: finite common admitted inputs; shared parser/encoder; no CPU isolation, total lifecycle, RSS, model-cost or production guarantee
